item.title: Thank You, Columbus Public Health
item.description:
Dear Columbus Public Health Colleagues:

More than two years into this global pandemic, we are continuing to learn how to coexist with what remains an unrelenting and unpredictable virus. There are clear signs of progress throughout our community and across the nation — ample evidence for optimism and relief as normalcy is restored and beloved traditions return to daily life in Columbus.

At the same time, we continue to come to terms with the fact that there will be no definitive end to this virus but rather a series of unique and compelling chapters, each with its own successes and obstacles, advances and setbacks, surprises and revelations. No matter what the next challenge may be, I am certain that our incredible public health professionals will continue to lead with unflinching bravery, unshakeable determination and a keen awareness of the latest scientific breakthroughs to protect our community and enable our residents to thrive.

Each of you represents healing and hope, and each of you leads by example. No matter the challenge, you rise to meet it. You never waver in your service to your patients, to your profession and to the great City of Columbus. We are a healthier and stronger community because you stand by us and guide us through difficult times – all while providing essential services to keep our residents well and enable our city to function safely.

Words cannot effectively convey my gratitude or the gratitude of a grateful city, but know that we are so deeply appreciative of everything you do, and we admire your commitment to health, wellness and the advancement of society. We never, for one second, take you or your impact for granted. Thank you.

Sincerely,
